今天已经是八月十三号了，也是他回城的日子。

王建新早早起来，把被子叠成豆腐块，床单铺得平平整整。他在宿舍里转了一圈，看了看这间住了不到一个月的小屋——书桌、椅子、衣柜，墙上贴的作息时间表。东西不多，但住了这些天，也有感情了。

他先来到政治处，找到刘干事。

“来了？”刘干事从抽屉里拿出一个牛皮纸信封，递给他，“这是你的入学通知书。团组织关系介绍信也在里面，你是团员，需要将所有关系转至北京医学院团委。还需要凭通知书办理户口迁出，同时将粮食关系转入北京医学院。”

王建新接过信封，打开看了看。入学通知书是一张纸，上面印着“北京医学院”几个大字，写着他的名字、报到日期。盖上大红公章，看着就正式。

刘干事又说：“其他的档案材料，由部队机要通道寄出，不需要本人携带。你人到了学校，档案也就到了。”

“明白了。谢谢刘干事。”

从政治处出来，王建新回到宿舍，开始整理个人生活用品。军装——四个兜的夏常服、冬常服、衬衣、大衣，全套都带上。被褥、床单、枕头，部队发的，叠好了打成一个背包。洗漱用品——脸盆、牙缸、毛巾、肥皂，装进网兜里。

他把所有行李按学习的打包方法，用绑带全部绑好，整整齐齐的。一个背包，一个帆布包，一个网兜，再加上那辆自行车，就是他的全部家当。

然后他来到办公楼，和张团长、李参谋长、周副团长、王副团长、姚副团长一一告别。

张团长坐在办公桌后面，看见他进来，站起来，从抽屉里拿出一张火车票，递给他：“八月十八号，包头到北京票给你买好了。”

王建新接过车票，心里一热。军人就是好，不光没有任何花销，衣食住行全包。出行还能报销。

“车已经安排好了，李班长送你去包头火车站。”张团长走过来，拍了拍他的肩膀，“去了学校好好学习，别给咱们团丢人。”

“是！首长放心！”

李参谋长握了握他的手：“好好学，以后咱们团的伤病员就指望你了。”

周副团长也来了，气色比之前好多了，脸上有了血色。他握着王建新的手，用力摇了摇：“小王，到了北京替我向你父母问好。以后有什么事，尽管给我打电话。”

王副团长的大嗓门又在走廊里响了：“小王，好好学！学好了回来给咱们团的人看病！”

姚副团长话不多，只是拍了拍他的肩膀，点了点头。

王建新一一敬礼，一一告别。

出了办公楼，李班长已经把吉普车开到了门口。他的自行车绑在吉普车后面，用绳子固定得牢牢的。行李放在后座，背包靠在椅背上。

王建新上了车，坐在副驾驶。吉普车发动起来，缓缓驶出团部大门。

他回头看了一眼。办公楼、操场、红旗、杨树，还有那些站在门口朝他挥手的首长们。这个待的时间并不长、但有了深厚感情的团部，一点点变小，最后消失在天边。

王建新转过头，心里五味杂陈。

从草原到团部，从团部到学校，一步一步，离家乡越来越近了。

李班长开着车，话不多，但时不时跟他说几句。两人聊了聊训练时的趣事，李班长说他第一天五公里越野跑进优秀线的时候，全连都震惊了。王建新笑了笑，没说什么。

从团部到包头火车站，路不近。吉普车开了大半天，到了火车站已经是下午了。

李班长把车停好，解下自行车，帮王建新把行李搬下来。两人一起到托运处，办了自行车托运。填了单子，交了钱，自行车推进了行李站，会跟车一起运到北京。

办完托运，李班长又把王建新送到站台上。火车已经停在那里了，绿皮车厢，跟一年前王建新坐的那趟差不多。李班长帮他把行李拎上车，找到座位放好。

“李班长，谢谢你。”王建新伸出手。

李班长握了握他的手，笑着说：“好好学，王排长。咱们后会有期。”

“后会有期。”

李班长下了车，站在站台上，朝他挥了挥手。王建新从车窗里伸出手，也挥了挥。

汽笛响了。火车缓缓发动，哐当哐当，越来越快。

王建新靠在座椅上，看着窗外的站台越来越远，李班长的身影越来越小。火车驶出了车站，驶向远方。

这次回去，和来的时候心情不一样，身体状况更不一样。一年前，他是一个十五岁的少年，身体瘦弱，心里忐忑，不知道草原上等着他的是什么。现在，他穿着一身军装，兜里揣着入学通知书和一等功证书，身体炼气四层，空间里堆着成山的物资。

没有觉得累，只觉得很兴奋。马上就能回家了。马上就能见到爸、妈、大哥、大嫂、二哥、小妹了。

还有一种情绪——马上就能去北京了。七十年代的北京是什么样子的？他想看看故宫，看看天安门，看看这个年代的京城。

火车哐当哐当地跑着。王建新看着窗外，田野、村庄、城镇，一幕一幕地从眼前掠过。河北、北京，越来越近。

Today is August 13th, and it is also the day he returns to the city.

Wang Jianxin got up early, folded the quilt into tofu blocks, and spread the sheets evenly.He walked around the dormitory and looked at the small room he had lived in for less than a month - the desk, chairs, wardrobe, and the schedule posted on the wall.There are not many things, but after living there for these days, I have feelings for it.

He first came to the political office and found Director Liu.

"Here?" Officer Liu took out a kraft paper envelope from the drawer and handed it to him, "This is your admission notice. A letter of introduction to the league organization is also inside. You are a league member and need to transfer all relations to the Youth League Committee of Beijing Medical College. You also need to use the notice to transfer your household registration and transfer your food relations to Beijing Medical College."

Wang Jianxin took the envelope, opened it and looked at it.The admission notice was a piece of paper with "Beijing Medical College" printed on it, along with his name and registration date.Stamped with a big red official seal, it looks official.

Officer Liu added: "Other archive materials will be sent through the military's confidential channels and do not need to be carried by yourself. When you arrive at the school, the archives will also arrive."

"I understand. Thank you, Director Liu."

After coming out of the political office, Wang Jianxin returned to his dormitory and began to sort out his personal belongings.Military uniforms—four pockets of summer uniforms, winter uniforms, shirts, and overcoats. Bring the whole set.Bedding, sheets, and pillows were issued by the army, folded and tied into a backpack.Toiletries - washbasin, dental bowl, towels, soap, put in mesh bags.

He tied all the luggage neatly with straps according to the packing method he had learned.A backpack, a canvas bag, a net bag, and the bicycle were all his belongings.

Then he came to the office building and said goodbye to Commander Zhang, Chief of Staff Li, Deputy Commander Zhou, Deputy Commander Wang, and Deputy Commander Yao one by one.

Captain Zhang was sitting behind his desk. When he saw him coming in, he stood up, took out a train ticket from the drawer and handed it to him: "On August 18th, the ticket from Baotou to Beijing has been bought for you."

Wang Jianxin took the ticket and felt warm in his heart.Being a soldier is great. Not only does it cost nothing, but all food, clothing, housing and transportation are included.Travel can also be reimbursed.

"The car has been arranged. Squad Leader Li will take you to Baotou Railway Station." Captain Zhang came over and patted his shoulder, "Go to school and study hard. Don't embarrass our group."

"Yes! Don't worry, chief!"

Chief of Staff Li shook his hand: "Study hard, and the sick and wounded in our regiment will count on you in the future."

Vice-leader Zhou also came, looking much better than before, with blood on his face.He held Wang Jianxin's hand and shook it vigorously: "Xiao Wang, when you get to Beijing, say hello to your parents for me. If you need anything in the future, just call me."

Deputy Commander Wang's loud voice rang out in the corridor again: "Xiao Wang, study hard! Once you've learned enough, come back and treat the people in our group!"

Deputy Captain Yao didn't say much, he just patted him on the shoulder and nodded.

Wang Jianxin saluted and said goodbye one by one.

After leaving the office building, Squad Leader Li had already driven the jeep to the door.His bike was tied to the back of the jeep, securely secured with a rope.The luggage was placed in the back seat and the backpack was propped against the back of the seat.

Wang Jianxin got into the car and sat in the passenger seat.The jeep started and slowly drove out of the regiment headquarters gate.

He glanced back.Office buildings, playgrounds, red flags, poplar trees, and the leaders standing at the door waving to him.This regiment, which didn't stay long but had deep feelings for it, became smaller and smaller, and finally disappeared into the horizon.

Wang Jianxin turned his head, feeling mixed in his heart.

From the grassland to the regiment headquarters, from the regiment headquarters to the school, step by step, we are getting closer and closer to our hometown.

Monitor Li drove the car and didn't talk much, but he said a few words to him from time to time.The two chatted about interesting things during training. Squad leader Li said that when he entered the excellent line in the five-kilometer cross-country run on the first day, the whole company was shocked.Wang Jianxin smiled and said nothing.

The road from the regiment headquarters to Baotou Railway Station is not close.The jeep drove for a long time, and it was already afternoon when we arrived at the train station.

Monitor Li parked the car, took off his bicycle, and helped Wang Jianxin unload his luggage.The two of them went to the shipping office together and checked in their bicycles.After filling out the form and paying the money, the bicycle was pushed into the luggage station and will be transported to Beijing with the car.

After finishing the check-in, Squad Leader Li sent Wang Jianxin to the platform.The train has stopped there, and the green carriage is similar to the one Wang Jianxin took a year ago.Monitor Li helped him carry his luggage into the car, find a seat and put it away.

"Monitor Li, thank you." Wang Jianxin stretched out his hand.

Squad Leader Li shook his hand and said with a smile: "Study hard, Platoon Leader Wang. We will see you later."

"See you later."

Monitor Li got off the bus, stood on the platform, and waved to him.Wang Jianxin stretched out his hand from the car window and waved.

The whistle blew.The train started slowly, clanging, clanging, clanging, getting faster and faster.

Wang Jianxin leaned on his seat and watched the platform outside the window getting farther and farther away, and the figure of Squad Leader Li getting smaller and smaller.The train left the station and headed into the distance.

When I went back this time, my mood was different from when I came here, and my physical condition was even different.A year ago, he was a fifteen-year-old boy, thin and anxious, not knowing what was waiting for him on the grassland.Now, he is wearing a military uniform, with an admission notice and a first-class merit certificate in his pocket. His body is on the fourth level of Qi refining, and there are mountains of supplies piled in the space.

I didn't feel tired, I just felt excited.You can go home soon.You can see your father, mother, eldest brother, sister-in-law, second brother and little sister soon.

There is another emotion - I can go to Beijing soon.What was Beijing like in the 1970s?He wanted to see the Forbidden City, Tiananmen Square, and the capital of this era.

The train clattered along.Wang Jianxin looked out the window as fields, villages, and towns passed by one scene after another.Hebei and Beijing are getting closer and closer.
